acoustic._note: Populated automatically after SDK upload. Reused on subsequent runs — no browser re-discovery needed.

inspection._ecommerceSchemaNote: Set to 'ga4' (ecommerce.items[]), 'ua' (ecommerce.detail/add/purchase.products[]), or 'custom'. Detected automatically during onboarding.

ecommerceEventMap._note: Maps signal type → actual dataLayer event name discovered on this site
ecommerceEventMap._removedFromCartNote: Set to the dataLayer event name observed when a product is removed from the cart (e.g. 'remove_from_cart', 'cartRemove'). Leave empty if no such event is detected — the skill will document this as unverified in the implementation review. When set, the value is automatically added to GAeventsAllowList and a dual-branch enhance is generated for the addToCart signal block.

inspection._ecommerceItemsPathNote: For 'custom' schema only: dot-path from ecommerce object to items array, e.g. 'detail.products'

accountRegistered._triggerTypeNote: Two triggers generated automatically: change (email capture on form) + LOAD (fire on success page). No manual trigger config needed.
accountRegistered._registrationMethodNote: Set to 'email', 'sso', 'google', 'facebook', or whichever method this customer uses.
accountRegistered._successUrlPatternsNote: Partial path strings — the enhance function uses indexOf(). Add the actual success URL pattern for this customer.
accountRegistered._formUrlPatternsNote: Partial path strings for the registration form page. Used to limit email capture to registration forms only.
